test_name: Augmentation dots stay beside their noteheads on and off ledger lines
description: Audit 2026-11-02 H3. cnb:dots-avoid-ledgers (cnb/dots.ly) moves the dot of a note on a ledger line one staff-position away from the staff. It used to set the dot's staff-position to the notehead's absolute position plus the dodge, but the dot is positioned relative to its notehead, so the notehead's offset was counted twice: c'2. put its dot 6.5 staff spaces below the note and e'''2. 8.5 above. Every measure holds one dotted half; positions are read as staff_relative.staff_spaces_from_center (1.0 = one staff space, one staff-position = 0.5). Dots of notes on ledger lines must sit exactly half a staff space away from their notehead, below the staff downward and above it upward; dots of notes in spaces (inside the staff or between ledger lines) stay level with the notehead, and the note on a staff line keeps LilyPond's own upward half-space shift.

assertions._comment: === SECTION 1: ON LEDGER LINES BELOW THE STAFF: DOT HALF A SPACE BELOW ===

assertions.description: Bb3 (on a ledger line below the staff): dot half a staff space below its notehead
C4 (on a ledger line below the staff): dot half a staff space below its notehead
D4 (on a ledger line below the staff): dot half a staff space below its notehead
E4 (on a ledger line below the staff): dot half a staff space below its notehead

assertions._comment: === SECTION 2: ON LEDGER LINES ABOVE THE STAFF: DOT HALF A SPACE ABOVE ===

assertions.description: C6 (on a ledger line above the staff): dot half a staff space above its notehead
D6 (on a ledger line above the staff): dot half a staff space above its notehead
E6 (on a ledger line above the staff): dot half a staff space above its notehead
G#6 (on a ledger line above the staff): dot half a staff space above its notehead

assertions._comment: === SECTION 3: BETWEEN LEDGER LINES: DOT LEVEL WITH THE NOTEHEAD ===

assertions.description: A3 (between ledger lines below the staff): dot level with its notehead
B3 (between ledger lines below the staff): dot level with its notehead
C#4 (between ledger lines below the staff): dot level with its notehead
F6 (between ledger lines above the staff): dot level with its notehead

assertions._comment: === SECTION 4: INSIDE THE STAFF: UNCHANGED BY THE CALLBACK ===

assertions.description: G4 (in a staff space): dot level with its notehead
B4 (in a staff space): dot level with its notehead
E5 (on the top staff line): LilyPond's own avoidance lifts the dot half a staff space

assertions._comment: === SECTION 5: EVERY DOTTED NOTE HAS ITS DOT ===

assertions.description: All 15 dotted notes carry a dot
